reading: The sketch lays out a full 'Team members' admin page: a page heading with subtitle and an Invite button, a filter toolbar, a dark selection bar for bulk actions, a large data table card listing team members, an open status-filter dropdown menu floating over the table, and a pager row at the bottom. A typed note also sets page-wide styling (pale grey background, Helvetica, navy text).
